sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders are in excellent form with five straight wins before a recent draw, so they will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have lost their last five games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after a recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a notable clash between two of the division's stronger performers—Bridgnorth recently returned to winning ways after a loss, while Eccleshall will seek to bounce back from defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in an all-Wolverhampton affair, with Casuals in solid form while Wednesfield have shown some inconsistency. Bilston Town (fifth) travel to Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while Barnton host Shawbury United; Shawbury are struggling with five consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town face New Mills at home, with both sides in the lower half seeking points. Brereton Social host Widnes Town—Widnes remain bottom without a win and will face a tough test against an improving Brereton side. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's weakest performers. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with both teams fighting to escape the relegation zone.
